# awscc_agentregistry_registry_record (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::AgentRegistry::RegistryRecord



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the registry record was created.
- `description` (String) The description of the registry record.
- `descriptors` (Attributes) The typed set of descriptors for a registry record. Exactly one descriptor field is populated based on the record type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--descriptors))
- `display_name` (String) The human-readable display name of the registry record.
- `name` (String) The name of the registry record.
- `record_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the registry record.
- `record_id` (String) The unique identifier of the registry record.
- `record_type` (String) The type of the registry record.
- `record_version` (String) The version of the registry record.
- `registry_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the registry containing the record.
- `registry_id` (String) The identifier of the registry containing the record.
- `status` (String) The lifecycle status of the registry record.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags to assign to the registry record. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the registry record was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--descriptors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `descriptors`

Read-Only:

- `a2_a_agent_card` (Attributes) The A2A agent card descriptor, populated when the record type is AGENT. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--descriptors--a2_a_agent_card))
- `agent_skills_definition` (Attributes) The agent skills definition descriptor, populated when the record type is SKILL. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--descriptors--agent_skills_definition))
- `custom` (Attributes) The custom descriptor, populated when the record type is CUSTOM. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--descriptors--custom))
- `mcp_server` (Attributes) The MCP server descriptor, populated when the record type is MCP. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--descriptors--mcp_server))

<a id="nestedatt--descriptors--a2_a_agent_card"></a>
### Nested Schema for `descriptors.a2_a_agent_card`

Read-Only:

- `data` (String) Descriptor payload data.
- `data_schema_version` (String) Version of the descriptor type schema.
- `source` (Attributes) The source configuration that defines where descriptor content is retrieved from. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--descriptors--a2_a_agent_card--source))

<a id="nestedatt--descriptors--a2_a_agent_card--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `descriptors.a2_a_agent_card.source`

Read-Only:

- `from_url` (Attributes) URL-based descriptor source configuration, with credential provider configurations for authenticated URL retrieval. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--descriptors--a2_a_agent_card--source--from_url))

<a id="nestedatt--descriptors--a2_a_agent_card--source--from_url"></a>
### Nested Schema for `descriptors.a2_a_agent_card.source.from_url`

Read-Only:

- `credential_provider_configurations` (Attributes List) The credential providers used to authenticate when fetching descriptor content from the source URL. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--descriptors--a2_a_agent_card--source--from_url--credential_provider_configurations))
- `url` (String) URL source for descriptor content.

<a id="nestedatt--descriptors--a2_a_agent_card--source--from_url--credential_provider_configurations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `descriptors.a2_a_agent_card.source.from_url.credential_provider_configurations`

Read-Only:

- `credential_provider` (Attributes) The credential provider details. Specify exactly one member. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--descriptors--a2_a_agent_card--source--from_url--credential_provider_configurations--credential_provider))
- `credential_provider_type` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--descriptors--a2_a_agent_card--source--from_url--credential_provider_configurations--credential_provider"></a>
### Nested Schema for `descriptors.a2_a_agent_card.source.from_url.credential_provider_configurations.credential_provider`

Read-Only:

- `iam_credential_provider` (Attributes) IAM credential provider configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--descriptors--a2_a_agent_card--source--from_url--credential_provider_configurations--credential_provider--iam_credential_provider))
- `oauth_credential_provider` (Attributes) OAuth credential provider configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--descriptors--a2_a_agent_card--source--from_url--credential_provider_configurations--credential_provider--oauth_credential_provider))

<a id="nestedatt--descriptors--a2_a_agent_card--source--from_url--credential_provider_configurations--credential_provider--iam_credential_provider"></a>
### Nested Schema for `descriptors.a2_a_agent_card.source.from_url.credential_provider_configurations.credential_provider.iam_credential_provider`

Read-Only:

- `region` (String) The SigV4 signing region.
- `role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role.
- `service` (String) The SigV4 signing service name.


<a id="nestedatt--descriptors--a2_a_agent_card--source--from_url--credential_provider_configurations--credential_provider--oauth_credential_provider"></a>
